title: Cyclovirobuxine D alleviates aldosterone-induced myocardial hypertrophy by protecting mitochondrial function depending on the mutual regulation of Nrf2-SIRT3.
authors: Wang, Xueting; Wu, Hongkun; An, Jiangfei; Zhang, Guangqiong; Chen, Yan; Fu, Lingyun; Tao, Ling; Liang, Guiyou; Shen, Xiangchun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物对心肌肥厚的保护机制，涉及Nrf2-SIRT3蛋白互作，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cyclovirobuxine D (CVB-D) is a natural alkaloid that exhibits multiple pharmacological activities, such as anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative stress, and anti-cancer properties. However, its specific protective mechanism of action for myocardial hypertrophy remains unresolved. PURPOSE: This work was to investigate the ameliorative impact of CVB-D in myocardial hypertrophy, and to elucidate aldosterone (ALD)-induced myocardial hypertrophy by inhibiting the SIRT3 mediated Nrf2 activation. METHODS: The myocardial hypertrophy model was reproduced by ALD both in vitro and in vivo, and the protective effect of CVB-D on myocardium and mitochondria was evaluated by TEM, H&E, qPCR, Western blot and ChIP. An immunoprecipitation experiment was adopted to evaluate the acetylation level of Nrf2 and the binding between SIRT3 and Nrf2. Additionally, bardoxolone-methyl (BAR, an Nrf2 agonist), ML385 (an Nrf2 inhibitor), resveratrol (RES, a SIRT3 agonist), and 3-TYP (a SIRT3 inhibitor) were used to confirm the molecular mechanism of CVB-D. Lastly, a molecular docking technique was employed to predict the binding site of SIRT3 and Nrf2 proteins. RESULTS: Our findings suggested that CVB-D improved mitochondrial function, leading to a reduction in ALD-induced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy. By CVB-D treatment, there was an activation of mutual regulation between Nrf2 and SIRT3. Specifically, CVB-D resulted in the increase of Nrf2 protein in the nucleus and activated Nrf2 signaling pathway, thus up-regulating SIRT3. The activation of SIRT3 and the protective action of mitochondrion disappeared because of the intervention of ML385. After CVB-D activated SIRT3, the acetylation level of Nrf2 decreased, followed by activating the Nrf2 pathway. The activation of Nrf2 and mitochondrial protection by CVB-D were reversed by 3-TYP. Our results are also supported by Co-IP and molecular docking analysis, revealing that CVB-D promotes SIRT3-mediated Nrf2 activation. CONCLUSION: Thus, CVB-D ameliorates ALD-induced myocardial hypertrophy by recovering mitochondrial function by activating the mutual regulation of Nrf2 and SIRT3. Thus, CVB-D could be a beneficial drug for myocardial hypertrophy.
abstract_zh: 背景：环维黄杨星D（CVB-D）是一种天然生物碱，具有多种药理活性，如抗炎、抗氧化应激和抗癌特性。然而，其对心肌肥厚的具体保护作用机制仍未明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨CVB-D对心肌肥厚的改善作用，并阐明其通过抑制SIRT3介导的Nrf2激活来缓解醛固酮（ALD）诱导的心肌肥厚。方法：通过ALD在体外和体内复制心肌肥厚模型，并利用透射电子显微镜（TEM）、苏木精-伊红染色（H&E）、定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）、蛋白质印迹（Western blot）和染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）评估CVB-D对心肌和线粒体的保护作用。采用免疫沉淀实验评估Nrf2的乙酰化水平以及SIRT3与Nrf2之间的结合。此外，使用巴多索隆甲基（BAR，一种Nrf2激动剂）、ML385（一种Nrf2抑制剂）、白藜芦醇（RES，一种SIRT3激动剂）和3-TYP（一种SIRT3抑制剂）来确认CVB-D的分子机制。最后，采用分子对接技术预测SIRT3和Nrf2蛋白的结合位点。结果：我们的研究结果表明，CVB-D改善了线粒体功能，从而减少了ALD诱导的心肌细胞肥大。通过CVB-D处理，Nrf2和SIRT3之间的相互调节被激活。具体而言，CVB-D导致细胞核中Nrf2蛋白增加，并激活Nrf2信号通路，从而上调SIRT3。由于ML385的干预，SIRT3的激活和线粒体的保护作用消失。在CVB-D激活SIRT3后，Nrf2的乙酰化水平降低，随后激活Nrf2通路。CVB-D对Nrf2的激活和线粒体保护作用被3-TYP逆转。我们的结果也得到共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）和分子对接分析的支持，揭示CVB-D促进SIRT3介导的Nrf2激活。结论：因此，CVB-D通过激活Nrf2和SIRT3的相互调节来恢复线粒体功能，从而改善ALD诱导的心肌肥厚。因此，CVB-D可能成为治疗心肌肥厚的有益药物。
